excerpt_i18n.en: On December 4, three days after its launch, Doubao Mobile Assistant issued a "Statement on Adjusting AI Mobile Operation Capabilities," announcing plans to standardize adjustments to its AI mobile operation features in certain scenarios over the coming period. It emphasized active communication with stakeholders to promote clearer, more predictable rules, avoiding a one-size-fits-all approach that denies users reasonable rights to use AI. As a new product, the preview version of Doubao Mobile Assistant garnered widespread social attention after its launch. Official videos showcased its capabilities, such as helping users order food, book flights, compare prices for shopping, and even reply to WeChat messages or operate mini-program games. However, after the official launch, multiple users reported restrictions on logging into third-party products like WeChat when using the "mobile operation feature." Rumors later circulated that Doubao Mobile Assistant accessed system capabilities without authorization. In response, Doubao Mobile Assistant clarified that AI mobile operations require explicit user authorization, and users can interrupt tasks at any time. For sensitive authorizations involving third-party apps, users must manually confirm twice. Nevertheless, some controversies persist, arguing that user data authorization cannot substitute for third-party platform authorization. "It can act as a messenger, coordinator, feedback provider, and linker across various apps and intelligent agents, greatly facilitating user experience and improving efficiency," said Lü Peng, Deputy Director of the Wuhan Institute for Artificial Intelligence at Peking University. "Serving humanity with technology is the baseline," he added, "and humans should not be deprived of the right to use it."
excerpt_i18n.es: El 4 de diciembre, tres días después de su lanzamiento, Doubao Asistente Móvil publicó una "Declaración sobre el ajuste de las capacidades de operación de teléfonos por IA", indicando que planea realizar ajustes estandarizados en las capacidades de operación de teléfonos por IA en ciertos escenarios durante un período próximo. También enfatizó que se comunicará activamente con todas las partes, con la esperanza de promover la formación de reglas más claras y predecibles, evitando negar el derecho de los usuarios a utilizar razonablemente la IA de manera uniforme. Como novedad, la versión preliminar de Doubao Asistente Móvil ha generado una amplia atención social tras su lanzamiento. En el video oficial, la versión preliminar demostró su capacidad para ayudar a los usuarios a pedir comida a domicilio, reservar billetes de avión, comparar precios al comprar e incluso responder mensajes de WeChat.
